title: Bali Couple Retreat
headline: Ubud rice terraces, then Seminyak evenings by the sea.
description: Six nights in Bali for two: three in Ubud, three on the southwest coast, with one temple or sunrise add-on if you wish.
image_alt: Turquoise water and cliffs on the Bali coast
price_label: Quoted for your villas and dates
price_guidance: Bali pricing depends on villa or hotel category, private driver days and whether you add a sunrise trek or Uluwatu evening. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s Bali with two stays, not a hotel every night. Ubud for rice terraces, temples and quieter evenings; Seminyak for beach clubs, sunsets and a last stretch by the Indian Ocean. Private transfers keep the days yours.
highlights: Three nights in Ubud with a terrace or temple morning.
Tegallalang or a nearby village walk at an easy pace.
Three nights in Seminyak or a neighbouring beach village.
Optional Uluwatu temple and kecak evening, if you add it.
why: Inland calm and a coastal close, without island-hopping.
Dietary needs, including vegetarian, flagged to villas in advance.
Visa-on-arrival guidance for Indian passports, coordinated with your tickets.
inclusions: Airport and inter-hotel transfers in a private vehicle
Breakfast on hotel or villa mornings
One private half-day driver in Ubud as quoted
exclusions: Mount Batur trek, spa rituals and paid cultural shows unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected boutique hotels or private villas
stay.room: Double occupancy; private pool villas on request

notes: Villa category, driver days and temple tickets are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. Ceremony days can close some sites. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested order: Ubud, then the southwest coast. Canggu or Uluwatu can replace Seminyak if that suits you better.
